tokens.name: signal-green
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary buttons, the cursor in the logo, the one thing on a screen that should be acted on. On light grounds use it only as a fill with on-green text on it, never as a line or as text (1.9:1 on ground).

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green used as text or a thin line: links, 'Connected', success words. 9.8:1 on dark ground, 5.5:1 on light ground.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal-green fill (9.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: The logo tile and app icon, in every theme. Not a UI surface: use ground or panel.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: The bar of the logo mark on its black tile, in every theme.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is the default look of the product; dark is the other.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, side panels, dialogs: one step up from ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, inputs inside panels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers. Hairline, 1px.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and headings on ground and panel (17:1 dark, 18:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body text that should sit back: descriptions, the words of an agent's report.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, times, costs, helper text (5.9:1 dark, 6:1 light). The smallest text allowed in this colour is 12px.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting for approval, near a budget. Words and icons; on light ground it is the darker value (4.7:1).

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Failed, stopped, over budget. Words, icons and card borders only, never a large fill.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Run your organization with AI agents
styles.usage: Website heroes and the cover of a deck. Once per page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on the website and in decks.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The Head of Marketing finished the spring campaign plan.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines under a title: who, when, what it cost.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and the wordmark's feel. Always uppercase, always tracked.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers that line up: costs, counts, ids, receipts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between items in a list or a row of buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside small cards and rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the page's minimum side margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Around the logo: clear space at 64px tile size.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on the website.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small buttons, the wordmark cursor when drawn as UI.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The logo tile at 64px: always a quarter of the tile's side.
